name: assistant-ui-ink-proto
description: Throwaway prototype for LIA-493 (wayfinder map LIA-492) — evaluating @assistant-ui/react-ink as a base for tui-v2's hand-rolled Ink screens. Self-contained scratch package, deliberately NOT wired into the real app's dependency tree. Two screens to be built by a later stage: (1) three-way permission prompt (allow-once/allow-always/deny), (2) tool-call result with structured diff + status glyph (success/error/unknown, never a false-positive green check on failure).
